phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
The soldiers were ambushed by enemy troops while scouting the house.
They found abandoned military supplies instead of poultry.
A wounded comrade required them to abort the mission.
They negotiated with the owner to trade supplies for food.
They stole a goose and escaped pursuit by dogs and the owner.
Heavy rainfall forced them to take shelter temporarily.
soldiers scouting a house and being ambushed by enemy troops
soldiers discovering abandoned military supplies instead of poultry
soldiers carrying a wounded comrade to abort the mission
soldiers negotiating with a homeowner to trade supplies for food
soldiers stealing a goose and escaping pursuit by dogs
soldiers taking shelter from heavy rainfall during a mission
